author: Ogrey
body:
Hey there.
So, my latest maps are no more than three simple void-maps with a small difference.
Motivated to introduce a new concept/experience to Nebula, I decided to play around with YML.
What was the aftermath? 4 team DTM matches.
They are possible. They are, of course, confusing as first, but once you get the easy hang of it, it turns out to be rather simple to understand.

For those who don't understand yet:
We will assume you have joined Red Team. In the Scoreboard, for Mute City 1 and Mute City 2, Red Team will have to destroy 'Green' and 'Yellow'. What does this mean? You'll have to destroy the red roofed monuments located on Green's side and Yellow's side. If an error message appears, then you're probably breaking the wrong monument (which would be a blue roofed one in this case).

Anyways. I've noticed there are quite a lot of comments about these maps, and I would like to know what you guys think. Are these maps fun or not?
Any sort of feedback will be welcome and please remember to submit your input in an organized and polite way, thanks.
